---
name: glaze-faults
description: Use when a potter describes a glaze defect after a firing, such as crawling, pinholes, crazing, shivering, running or blistering, and wants to know its cause and how to avoid it.
---

# Glaze faults

1. Name the most likely fault from what the potter describes.
2. Give its two or three usual causes, most likely first.
3. Suggest one change to try on the next firing, such as glaze thickness, a slower cool or a longer hold at peak.

Keep the reply short and practical.
